rawFindings.title: Incorrect use of url.resolve for PostAsset path
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaces pathFn.join with url.resolve to compute PostAsset.path. url.resolve interprets the second argument as a URL path and normalizes slashes, which may alter file path semantics especially if slugs contain special characters or spaces. Previously, pathFn.join was used to concatenate paths for file system usage, preserving spaces and exact filename characters. Using url.resolve can lead to incorrect path resolution, causing assets not to be found or linked incorrectly.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert to using pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug) to preserve exact path concatenation for filesystem paths.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If an asset slug is 'file with space', path becomes e.g. '/postpath/file%20with%20space' or incorrect path due to url.resolve interpretation, resulting in broken asset paths.
